description: Music playback message. gwent/music (retained) for play, gwent/music/complete for finished.

subkind.description: play: start a track. complete: track finished (from TUI, server-timer, or server).

music.description: Track name (without extension). Resolved to software/data/music/{name}.mp3

next_music.description: Next track to play after current finishes

started_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp with timezone when playback started. Clients joining late can seek to (now - started_at).

duration_seconds.description: Track duration in seconds. Server uses this to schedule auto-advance.

source.description: Who completed playback: gwent-tui, gwent-timer, gwent

game_id.description: Unique identifier for the current game session
